# Shruti 1.4.15
- Keeps every feature unlocked until license sales actually open, as the product page promises. A signing key shipped ahead of a working checkout had started the 14-day countdown, so installs reached day 15 and lost their mixer with nothing to buy. - Adds one explicit switch, `ShrutiLicenseSalesOpen`, that arms paid licensing. It is off in this release and turns on only alongside a live checkout link. - Restores full control of levels, mutes, boosts, effects, redirects and Smart features on any Mac that was locked out by the expired trial. Saved mixes were never touched. - Clears the red "Not activated" badge in Settings on builds where there is nothing to activate, and replaces the "internal testing access" line with what is actually true. - Ends refusal banners in a single full stop instead of two.
